items.title: Apple同步更新macOS三大分支版本，修補逾200個資安漏洞

items.title: 中國駭客Red Heron利用Gitea重大漏洞攻擊臺灣等多個國家
items.summary: Gitea開發團隊於7月底修補重大漏洞CVE-2026-60004，一個月後美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）警告該漏洞遭到積極利用，本週有資安公司指出，有駭客組織在概念驗證程式碼（PoC）公開後不久，將其用於實際攻擊。

items.title: Acronis修補cPanel與WHM備份外掛高風險漏洞，警示已遭攻擊者利用
items.summary: Acronis於9月11日發布更新，修補Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM的高風險漏洞，並警告該漏洞已遭攻擊者實際利用。Acronis未在公告中公布該漏洞的CVE編號、成因或攻擊方式，僅指出受影響的1.9.3以前版本用戶應儘速更新，目前最新版本則是1.9.3 HF3與1.9.4版。

items.title: 美AI業界憂中國追上，中國批惡性競爭
items.summary: 中國外交部周一（9/14）回應Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei日前提出的放慢前沿AI發展及防止中國追上等主張，批評散播威脅敘事、搞對抗及惡性競爭，只會干擾全球AI治理進程。

items.title: RouterOS漏洞風險升高！Shadowserver發現全球260萬臺MikroTik路由器暴露於網路，臺灣有近1.9萬臺
items.summary: 波蘭電腦緊急事件應變團隊CERT Polska於9月5日警告，MikroTik路由器作業系統RouterOS存在多項漏洞，部分已遭攻擊者利用；美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）也於9月10日將其中的CVE-2026-67277與CVE-2026-86060列入已遭利用漏洞（KEV）清單。

items.summary: fix(ui): settle global model drafts across agent switches (#148843) * fix(ui): settle global model defaults across agent switches Keep global default save completion scoped to its draft rather than the Settings agent. Connection resets still retire drafts, newer edits keep their object identity, and rejected operations retain the existing Retry owner. Completed recovery now follows later authoritative config updates. Protect the flow with paired Chromium Settings regressions for agent switching, rejected saves, retries, and external changes, plus a genuine replacement-draft case. * ci: rebalance update tests into services type graph Preserve exact-once test coverage and the existing root limits by grouping the complete update lifecycle family with service tests. Reproduced the infra 702-root failure on clean main; all three compiler graphs, owner tests, changed checks, and independent review pass.

items.title: fix(logging): orphaned \\\\?\\ path markers corrupt redacted Windows …
items.summary: fix(logging): orphaned \\\\?\\ path markers corrupt redacted Windows diagnostics (#147542) Closes #147502 ## What Problem This Solves Windows support diagnostics can leave `\\?\` before a directory label or expose a whole namespaced local path. ## User Impact Known paths use readable labels. Unmatched network/device paths remain useful diagnostic evidence, and repeated redaction stays stable. ## Why This Change Was Made The shared support redactor owns path replacement for exports, logs, and repair diagnostics. It recognizes absolute namespace spellings and consumes attached markers in embedded errors. Prefixes are prepared once per call; this state has one writer and no persistent cache. `diagnostic-support-redaction.ts`: +40/-3 lines for namespace matching and prefix reuse. Growth accepted under the owner's standing acceptance (2026-09-15). ## Evidence `pnpm openclaw gateway diagnostics export --output support-export.zip --json` with isolated state and real JSON logs: - Main `3dbc8e2`: an embedded error retains `\\?\` before `~`; a whole namespaced home path remains exposed. - Retained production proof at `24640dde`: both records use clean `~` labels; unmatched network/device paths and already redacted text are unchanged. Production remains byte-identical in the tests-only correction. - The committed regression now runs the registered export action with real log/config input, reads the ZIP, and re-exports its sanitized logs. It fails at contributor base `0c4a83f3` on orphaned markers and an exposed home path, then passes at the repaired head. - Both changed test modules pass: 64 tests. Unknown UNC/device paths, case-insensitive matching, and repeated redaction remain covered. - Preparing prefixes once removes repeated allocation: 15,000 strings take about 221 ms, matching main; sampled allocation falls about 14% versus the original patch. Retained contributor Windows 11 evidence at `2cd0bb3` uses a real 9 MB config rejected at the 8 MiB bound. Before: production export module with snapshot readers skipped. After: built CLI export. It was not reproduced on Windows during this review. The later network/device correction preserves that drive-path repair. | Export field | Before | After | | --- | --- | --- | | `config.error` | `File exceeds 8388608 bytes: \\?\$OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR\openclaw.json` | `File exceeds 8388608 bytes: $OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR\openclaw.json` | | `config.path` | `\\?\C:\Users\\AppData\Local\openclaw-winproof\openclaw.json` | `$OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR\openclaw.json` | ## Compatibility No config, filesystem, update, or service behavior changes. The ordinary macOS config path was already redacted on main; its log proof supplements the retained Windows filesystem evidence. ## Consumers Support exports, sanitized logs, trajectory metadata, and repair diagnostics use the same helpers. ## Invalidation No persistent state; prefixes are recomputed per call. ## Tests `FORCE_COLOR=0 NO_COLOR=1 TERM=dumb node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/cli/gateway-cli.coverage.test.ts src/logging/diagnostic-support-redaction.test.ts` Earlier cron and Gateway memory failures remain causally unclassified. Both affected groups passed on contributor merge `21f4b618` ([cron](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34930255490/job/104256993755), [Gateway](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34930255490/job/104256993892)); final-commit CI remains for review. AI-assisted: yes ## Retained review addendum The following records the review at `24640dde`, before the tests-only correction. Known Windows paths in diagnostics exports now use readable state-directory or home labels. The shared support redactor consumes an attached namespace marker and preserves unmatched network and device paths. `diagnostic-support-redaction.ts`: +40/-3 lines for absolute namespace candidates, embedded marker handling, and prefix reuse. Growth accepted under the owner's standing acceptance (2026-09-15). The real `openclaw gateway diagnostics export` command produced the malformed log output on main and clean labels on the candidate. The 26 owner, export, and log-tail tests passed on a tree containing the main merge. The Windows oversized-config result is retained contributor evidence; it was not reproduced during this review. Its before capture used the production export module, and its after capture used the built CLI. Preparing prefixes once per call removes repeated allocation. Five warmed samples of 15,000 strings returned to baseline latency; sampled allocation fell about 14% compared with the earlier patch. No filesystem, config, service, or update behavior changes. The earlier cron completion timeout and Gateway heap exhaustion remain causally unclassified. Both affected groups passed on the later contributor merge. Those passes predate the final allocation correction and are not final-head CI evidence. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
